title: 第634章 玄素之道第633章 鸽子生来不为排期
lines: 看着舰队离去，许平秋本来是想再说两句的，毕竟那句‘那就让清镜燃烧’，怎么听都找不到半点友好。
可转念一想，还是算了吧。
自己当年整活的时候，截云老登也从没拦过。
作为一个成熟的老登，最重要的品质，就是不要登味太重！
尤其是小登热血上头的时候，最应该做的是支持，而不是扫兴！
许平秋一时感慨万千，心里既欣慰，又有一种说不上来的微妙惆怅。
难怪老登总喜欢站在高处叹气，一开始他还以为截云道君搁这装逼呢。
如今轮到自己站在这个位置，他才发现，原来看着小登们兴致勃勃地推着一辆明显刹不住的车往山坡下冲，忍住不拦，确实需要很大的魄力。
“怎么了，是累累了吗？”乐临清偏过头，拉了拉许平秋的手手，问道：“要不我们回去休息了吧，今天已经足够努力了。”
她感觉秋秋好像在很努力地思考大事，可是秋秋已经思考了好多好多大事了，哪怕聪明的秋秋再厉害，也会累累的。
累累了，就应该回去躺一躺，这是很朴素的道理。
许平秋倒没有觉得什么累，除非是在面对慕语禾的时候，否则以他如今的境界，基本上谈不上疲倦。
就是单纯觉得科技树有点歪，毕竟真界外面，是真有不干净的东西啊！
不过，看完了这些，剩下的事，回乌阁里云一云，应该也是一样。
“那就听临清的。”
许平秋牵住乐临清的手，张开玄门，直接回了乌阁。
“好耶！”
乐临清用力地点了点头，开心回握了一下。
乌阁里一如往常安静，桌案上摆着尚未收起的玉简与几卷符书，旁边还趴着一只肥啾，正把脑袋埋在蓬松的翅膀里，睡得十分安详。
直到玄门气息一闪，它才警觉地抬起头。
它看见许平秋和乐临清回来，圆溜溜的小眼睛眨了眨，又重新趴了下去。
很显然，肥啾已经深刻认识到，在乌阁里，只要不是饭点，不要随便打扰这两个人。
乐临清拉着许平秋，一路小碎步穿过桌案，来到了神圣的软榻前。
她先松开了许平秋的手，空出的右手绕到脑后，指尖拈住那枚莹白的玉簪，轻轻一拔，满头青丝便哗地淌了下来。
“好舒服呀！”
她心满意足地舒了口气，随即转过身，看向坐着的许平秋，咻的一下扑了上去。
许平秋与乐临清一同仰在了柔软的榻上，微微偏过头，目光落在她脸上。
乐临清侧枕在他肩头，恰好仰起小半张脸来看，红唇微微抿着。
许平秋觉得自己是个很讲道理的人，面对这样看着他的清清老师，很难不尊师重道。
于是，他低头亲了上去。
檀口微启，噙香衔贝。
乐临清喉间溢出一丝软糯的轻唔，身子微微绷了一瞬，旋即便软了下来，任由许平秋使坏着。
浅青色的襦裙渐渐在作乱下散乱了开来，领口微敞，露出一截雪颈与隐现的锁骨。
可遗憾的是，乐山的真容却在封印下难以寻觅，但这种犹抱琵琶半遮面的探索感，反倒让许平秋更生了几分兴致。
于是这一下就变得稍稍久了些，直到灵境忽然传来消息的震动。
乐临清也收到了消息，她被迫地微微仰起头，红唇因为喘息轻微分开，含糊道：“好像有正事呀。”
“正事真不懂事。”
许平秋叹了口气，恋恋不舍地将手从她盈盈一握的腰间挪开。
“还，还早啦，那就先理一下吧，如果是晚上，就……就不理了吧。”乐临清安慰道，一面说着，一面微微侧过身，将散乱的衣襟拢了拢。

;;
Watching the fleet leave, Xu Pingqiu originally wanted to say a few more words. After all, the sentence "Then let the clear mirror burn" was not even remotely friendly no matter how I heard it.
But on second thought, I might as well forget it.
When I was reorganizing my life, Jie Yun Laoden never stopped me.
As a mature old man, the most important quality is not to be too heavy!
Especially when Xiao Deng is enthusiastic, the most important thing to do is to support, not to discourage!
"Alas."
Xu Pingqiu was filled with emotions for a moment, feeling both relieved and indescribably subtle.
No wonder Lao Deng always likes to stand on high places and sigh. At first, he thought Taoist Jie Yun was just showing off.
Now that it was his turn to stand in this position, he realized that it really took a lot of courage to watch the young climbers happily pushing a car that obviously couldn't stop down the hillside and not to stop them.
"What's wrong, are you tired?" Le Linqing turned his head, took Xu Pingqiu's hand, and asked, "How about we go back and rest? We have worked hard enough today."
She felt that Qiuqiu was thinking hard about big things, but Qiuqiu had already thought about many big things. No matter how smart Qiuqiu was, she would still be tired.
When you are tired, you should go back and lie down. This is a very simple truth.
Xu Pingqiu didn't feel tired at all. Unless he was facing Mu Yuhe, with his current state, it was basically impossible to say he was tired.
I simply feel that the technology tree is a bit crooked. After all, there are really unclean things outside the real world!
However, after reading this, the rest of the things should be the same when I return to Wuge Liyun Yiyun.
"Then just listen to Linqing."
Xu Pingqiu took Le Linqing's hand, opened the Xuanmen, and returned directly to Wu Pavilion.
"Yeah!"
Le Linqing nodded vigorously and shook his head happily.
The Wu Pavilion was as quiet as usual. There were jade slips and several volumes of talismans that had not been put away on the table. Next to it lay a fat chirp, burying its head in its fluffy wings, sleeping very peacefully.
It wasn't until Xuanmen's breath flashed that it raised its head alertly.
"Chirp?"
When it saw Xu Pingqiu and Le Linqing coming back, it blinked its round eyes and lay down again.
Obviously, Fei Jiu has realized deeply that in Wu Pavilion, unless it is not a meal, he should not disturb these two people casually.
Le Linqing pulled Xu Pingqiu and walked across the table in small steps to the sacred soft couch.
She first let go of Xu Pingqiu's hand, then moved her free right hand around the back of her head. She grasped the crystal-white jade hairpin with her fingertips and pulled it out gently, causing green hair to drip down from her head.
“So comfortable!”
She breathed a sigh of contentment, then turned around, looked at Xu Pingqiu who was sitting, and pounced on him.
Xu Pingqiu and Le Linqing lay on the soft couch together, tilting their heads slightly and looking at her face.
"Huh?"
Le Linqing rested her head on his shoulder, raising half of her face to look at him, her red lips slightly pursed.
Xu Pingqiu felt that he was a very reasonable person. Faced with Teacher Qingqing who looked at him like this, it was difficult not to respect his teacher.
So, he lowered his head and kissed her.
The mouth of the sandalwood is slightly open, and the shell is holding the fragrance.
A soft soft moan escaped from Le Linqing's throat. His body tensed slightly for a moment, then softened, allowing Xu Pingqiu to do whatever he wanted.
The light blue skirt gradually fell apart due to the chaos, and the neckline was slightly open, revealing a snowy neck and looming collarbone.
Unfortunately, Leshan's true appearance is difficult to find under the seal, but this sense of exploration, half-hidden by the pipa, actually made Xu Pingqiu a little more interested.
So this time it took a little longer, until the news suddenly came from the spiritual realm.
Le Linqing also received the news. She was forced to raise her head slightly, her red lips parted slightly due to her breathing, and said vaguely: "It seems like there is something serious."
"You really don't know what's going on."
Xu Pingqiu sighed and reluctantly moved his hand away from her tightly grasped waist.
"It's still early, so let's take care of it first. If it's night, just...just ignore it." Le Linqing comforted him. As he spoke, he turned slightly sideways and gathered up the scattered clothes.
